terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: A FRONT-BOX TRICYCLE cart: the rear half of a bicycle carries a two-wheeled box in line ahead of it on a ladder chassis -- an upper rail pair clamped at the head tube and a lower pair at the bottom bracket, both running forward along the box sides. Both pairs are clamped to the fixed frame, so nothing steers: the three spoked wheels are the only mechanisms, each a named pivot on its Z axle driving one instance of the wheel InstancedMesh. Zero sockets. Papaya-salad vendors on every soi. A weathered stainless cabinet under a chrome-framed glass case, a folded blue tarp on four chrome poles, the rear half of a steel bicycle behind it on two long rails.

reasoning: ONE body merge -- the sheet cabinet with chrome corner angles, rib and bottom rail, the chrome angle case frame with mullions and tray, four chrome poles, the folded tarp roll with its rounded long edges and rope ties, the bicycle rear half (head, top, down and seat tubes, stays, steerer stub, seat post, saddle, rack with stays, mudguard, cranks, pedals, chainring, cassette, chain), the swept handlebar with grips, and the ladder chassis of four rails with cross members and end caps -- ONE glazing merge of five panes, and ONE InstancedMesh of three spoked wheels: THREE draw calls of 4.

Two materials of the four allowed: steel (vertex colours: weathered stainless, chrome, tarp blue, tyre, rim, saddle black, chain) and real transparent glass at opacity 0.34 both-sided, since the case is glazed on four sides and the top.
One repetition system: three wheels off one geometry of two closed ring lathes (tyre, rim), a hub cylinder and 28 three-sided prism spokes -- every instance a named pivot.
Action readiness: three wheel pivots, one box collider, zero sockets, not breakable; nothing steers because both rail pairs are clamped to the fixed frame.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is a bicycle pushing a glazed steel box on two chassis rails a side: the rails have to be real tubes running from the head tube and bottom bracket along the box, the case has to be real transparency over a cabinet, the wheels have to be open spoked wheels or the bicycle reads as a toy, and the bicycle rear half has to be a coherent frame closing on the bottom bracket and hub or it reads as broken.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 1.80 x 1.52 x 0.60 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=4000 triangles, <=4 draw calls, <=4 materials, <=8 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus 3 named mechanism pivot(s); zero sockets; box collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

silhouette.description: A 0.58 x 0.39 cabinet from 0.30 to 1.05 under a 0.58 x 0.39 glass case to 1.31, four poles to 1.52 carrying a 0.80 x 0.47 tarp roll from 1.37 to 1.49 that overhangs the case toward the bicycle; bicycle rear half from the rear hub (-0.62, 0.26) through the bottom bracket (-0.50, 0.29) to the head tube at x 0.02, saddle top 0.86, handlebar 0.85; rails at y 0.71 (from x -0.25) and 0.26 (from -0.48) to the box front at 0.90, z +-0.215; cart wheels at x 0.53, z +-0.265.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: The plate has no absolute scale, so the size is anchored on the bicycle wheel: 300 of 882 plate px = 0.34 H, and the proxy reads its wheels at 0.34 H too; a 20-inch (0.518 m) wheel gives H = 1.52 m. Proxy w:h:d 1.215:1:0.389 gives 1.85 x 1.52 x 0.59; declared 1.80 x 1.52 x 0.60 (the previous 1.85 x 1.95 x 0.90 was the sidecar reading of the first plate). Proxy stations in H units, +X the front: rear hub -0.41 at 0.17; saddle top 0.55 at -0.28; head tube 0.0..0.03 from 0.33 to 0.53; upper rails at 0.47 from -0.04 to 0.56, lower rails at 0.17 the whole length; box 0.195..0.56 long and 0.27 wide, cabinet 0.17..0.73, case 0.73..0.91; tarp 0.0..0.60 long, 0.34 wide, 0.91..1.0; cart wheels at x 0.377, z +-0.16. Built: rear tyre -0.879 to box front 0.89 (1.77 of the declared 1.80); y 0 to 1.52 at the pole tips; z +-0.32 at the cart tyres and handlebar grips (0.64 against the declared 0.60, the grip ends recorded). Band table of the build against the proxy: mean |delta w| 0.059, |delta d| 0.016; case bands 6-7 within 0.015; band 5 (+0.27) is the 5-95 percentile catching the saddle and handlebar that the proxy trimmed; band 2 (-0.11) is the open rear wheel sampled thinner than the proxy disc.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate: w:h:d 1.215:1:0.389, 3,622 triangles. Its side view puts the box in line ahead of the head tube and its end view puts two cart wheels at z +-0.16 H with the bicycle wheel on the centreline, which is what settled the layout as a front-box tricycle. It fused the tarp onto the case top; the plate shows a gap of air under the roll and the poles proud of it, and the build follows the plate there.

viewEvidence.note: NOT DIRECTLY OBSERVED. Confidence 0.80: the -Z side mirrors the +Z side (rails, cart wheel, cabinet face); the proxy end view shows the second cart wheel and the far rail ends.

evidence: Measured on viewEvidence region-cabinet (0.754) at #6e6d68 and region-bar at #7f7e7a; carried as vertex colours on a WHITE material: cabinet #8c8b86 (lifted 30 levels so side-lit faces stay above the turntable backdrop luma of 58), lower band #7e7d78, chrome #b9bcbf off region-frame, tarp #6f829a off region-tarp #65778a, tyre #6a6a68 off region-tyre #464440 (lifted for the hole gate), rim #c4c4c0, spokes #d4d4d0 off region-wheel, saddle #4a4a48.

textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

reviewHistory.summary: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.91. 3,836/4,000 triangles, 3/4 draw calls, 2/4 materials, 3/8 unique geometries, one 256 px canvas. Open bicycle: turntable with --allow-holes on the _holecc measurement (the openings in the frame, under the box and between spokes are real air).

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the large class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Two components and one repetition system: 3 of 4.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 3,836 of 4,000: thirty-seven boxes, a saddle ellipsoid, sixteen cylinders, thirty-eight tubes, and a 576-triangle spoked wheel instanced three times.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Boxes for the cabinet, case frame, tarp folds, rack, cranks and chain; cylinders for the poles, roll edges, chainring, hubs and mudguard; tubes for the frame, bar, rails and axles; an ellipsoid saddle; ring lathes and prism spokes for the wheels.
One InstancedMesh: three spoked wheels, each a named pivot with its instance index.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
Both materials are declared textureless. One 256 px grime canvas after construction, 0.25 MB.
